films.title: STREET DRUGS
films.synopsis: BREAKING NEWS! Scientists at the University of Weedmount have discovered a brand new type of substance that will change the medical industry forever! Join Two Guys News, hosted by Bob and his co-anchor Gareth Dingleberry, as they cover the groundbreaking discovery and the growing craze surrounding it. But as interest in the substance spreads, their latest story begins to take an unexpected turn.
films.funFact: During our highschool videography class, we were originally tasked with creating a video PSA. We weren’t too excited by the basic concept and wanted to make something with a bit more purpose, so we came up with our own idea instead. We wrote the script in one evening, filmed the entire thing the next day, and spent the following day editing (Gareth & I didn't sleep). Somehow, we finished and submitted it on time. Total production time: 3 days.

films.title: STREET DRUGS 3
films.synopsis: Following the events of STREET DRUGS, Gareth Dingleberry awakens alone in the middle of a field and quickly rushes back to Two Guys News headquarters. Desperate to spread the word about the STREET DRUGS crisis, Gareth is baffled to discover that nobody else remembers it ever happening. Labelled as insane, he is forced into therapy, where he must confront the possibility that the crisis—and perhaps his own memories—may not be what they seem.
films.funFact: Currently in post-production. Aiming for a 2027 release date.

films.title: K-Town Noir
films.synopsis: A connoisseur of various drugs and substances, private investigator Spike Douglas is contacted by Brian, an NSA agent, with a case that could threaten national security. Convinced that the elusive John Shady is at the center of it all, Spike throws himself into the investigation, following every lead with absolute certainty that he is closing in on his target. But when one crucial moment forces him to question what he has been chasing, the case begins to unravel, along with Spike’s understanding of what was ever real in the first place.
films.funFact: This was my FILM 392 assignment at Queen's University! We wanted to try out a more a Noir styled film.

films.title: Shelter
films.synopsis: Amid Canada’s ongoing housing crisis, Kingston real estate agent Jason Eade sets out to create a documentary of his own. Through the KCFF Doc Factory, he explores the challenges facing landlords in today’s housing market, the broader issues shaping the crisis, and potential solutions, all while navigating the process of bringing his perspective to the screen.
films.funFact: This was my FILM 392 documentary assignment at Queen's University!

films.title: The Bachelorette Party
films.synopsis: On the eve of her wedding, Aleeza and her bridesmaids gather for a night of drinks, laughter, and a classic game of dares—the King’s Game. But when Kyoko discovers a mysterious cross in their Airbnb, a dark curiosity awakens within the group. Faced with impossible choices and mounting terror, Aleeza must confront the horrifying reality that some games are never meant to be played.
films.funFact: This short film was selected to be screened in the 2025 Kingston Film Festival! It was also my FILM 250 assignment.
